definitions.text_mt: B'wiċċ b'ieħor, li mhux sincier fl-imġiba tiegħu
Li għandu pil jew xagħar ta' kuluri differenti, speċjalment ta' annimal

usage_examples.maltese: Dak il-politikant huwa faċċol; qatt ma taf x'jaħseb verament.
usage_examples.english: That politician is two-faced; you never know what he really thinks.

usage_examples.maltese: Il-qattus tagħna huwa faċċol, b'tikek suwed u bojod.
usage_examples.english: Our cat is piebald, with black and white spots.

usage_examples.maltese: Tafdahx, għax raġel faċċol jgħidlek ħaġa u mbagħad jagħmel oħra.
usage_examples.english: Don't trust him, because a two-faced man tells you one thing and then does another.

definitions.text_mt: Persuna li turi wiċċ differenti minn dak li verament għandha, ipokrita

usage_examples.maltese: Dan faċċol magħruf; l-aħjar li toqgħod attent minnu.
usage_examples.english: He is a well-known hypocrite; you'd better be careful of him.

usage_examples.maltese: Il-faċċoli jħobbu juru li huma tajbin imma fil-verità jaħsbu ħażin.
usage_examples.english: Hypocrites like to appear good but in truth think badly.

definitions.text_mt: Joħroġlu demm minn mnieħru, ikollu fsada mill-imnieħer

usage_examples.maltese: It-tifel faġar wara li ntlaqat b'ballun f'wiċċu.
usage_examples.english: The boy had a nosebleed after being hit in the face with a ball.

usage_examples.maltese: Jekk tifga, għolli rasek 'il fuq biex tieqaf tifgar.
usage_examples.english: If you have a nosebleed, tilt your head up to stop bleeding.

definitions.text_mt: Fsada mill-imnieħer, demm li joħroġ mill-imnieħer

usage_examples.maltese: Il-faġra damet kważi nofs siegħa qabel waqfet.
usage_examples.english: The nosebleed lasted almost half an hour before it stopped.

usage_examples.maltese: Ħafna drabi l-faġra sseħħ fix-xhur sħan tas-sajf.
usage_examples.english: Nosebleeds often occur in the hot summer months.

definitions.text_en: to have a good smell, scent, be fragrant
definitions.text_mt: Jinxef riħa tajba, ifuħ
Ikollu fama tajba, jitqies b'rispett
Jkun skars, jonqos il-provvista

usage_examples.maltese: Il-ward fil-ġnien faħ kollu madwaru.
usage_examples.english: The roses in the garden scented everything around them.

usage_examples.maltese: Isem dan il-ħwienet faħ ma' kulħadd fil-lokal.
usage_examples.english: This shop's name is well-reputed with everyone in the area.

usage_examples.maltese: L-ilma beda jfaħ f'dan ir-reġjun minħabba n-nixfa.
usage_examples.english: Water started to become scarce in this region due to the drought.

definitions.text_mt: Sustanza sewda li tinħaraq bħala karburant, magħmula minn injam jew materjal organiku ieħor maħruq parzjalment
Flus

usage_examples.maltese: Għadna bżonn nixtru faħam għall-barbecue tal-Ħadd.
usage_examples.english: We still need to buy charcoal for Sunday's barbecue.

usage_examples.maltese: Poġġi ftit faħam ieħor fuq in-nar qabel ma jitfi.
usage_examples.english: Put some more coal on the fire before it goes out.

usage_examples.maltese: Kemm għandek faħam biex tonfoq dal-ġimgħa?
usage_examples.english: How much money do you have to spend this week?

definitions.text_mt: Li jixbah lill-faħam fid-dehra, fil-kulur jew fin-natura

usage_examples.maltese: Il-ħitan ta' dik il-kamra huma ta' lewn faħmi skur.
usage_examples.english: The walls of that room are a dark coal colour.

usage_examples.maltese: Din il-blata għandha dehra faħmija u tleqqija metallika.
usage_examples.english: This rock has a coal-like appearance and metallic sheen.

definitions.text_en: obscenity, something outrageous, especially indecent talk
definitions.text_mt: Diskors jew imġiba oxxena u skandaluża, speċjalment b'mod sesswali

usage_examples.maltese: Qatt ma smajt daqshekk faħx f'ħajti; tlaqt immedjatament.
usage_examples.english: I've never heard such obscenity in my life; I left immediately.

usage_examples.maltese: Il-faħx m'għandu l-ebda lok f'konverżazzjoni ċivilizzata.
usage_examples.english: Obscenity has no place in a civilised conversation.

definitions.text_mt: Li fih faħx, li jikser il-morali
Li jikser il-pudur, speċjalment fid-diskors

usage_examples.maltese: Dan il-film huwa faħxi wisq għat-tfal iż-żgħar.
usage_examples.english: This film is too obscene for young children.

usage_examples.maltese: Uża lingwaġġ faħxi meta tkellem mal-ġenituri tiegħu, ġibduh.
usage_examples.english: He used indecent language when speaking to his parents; they scolded him.

definitions.text_mt: Oxxena, li tikser il-pudur, speċjalment mara jew nom femminil

usage_examples.maltese: Dik il-mara għamlet ġesti faħxija li xxukkjaw lil kulħadd.
usage_examples.english: That woman made obscene gestures that shocked everyone.

usage_examples.maltese: Il-kelma faħxija li qalet ma kellha l-ebda skuża.
usage_examples.english: The obscene word she said had no excuse.

definitions.text_mt: Oxxenità, diskors jew azzjoni faħxija

usage_examples.maltese: Din il-faħxija ma tistax tittollera f'soċjetà ċivilizzata.
usage_examples.english: This obscenity cannot be tolerated in a civilised society.

usage_examples.maltese: Il-faħxija tiegħu wasslitu għall-problemi mal-liġi.
usage_examples.english: His obscene behaviour got him into trouble with the law.

definitions.text_mt: Jgħid kelma tajba dwar xi ħadd jew xi ħaġa, ifaħħar
Jagħti ġieħ u glorja lil Alla

usage_examples.maltese: Il-kap faħħar lill-impjegati kollha għax-xogħol iebes tagħhom.
usage_examples.english: The boss praised all the employees for their hard work.

usage_examples.maltese: In-nies faħħru lil Alla bil-qawwa wara l-miraklu.
usage_examples.english: The people glorified God fervently after the miracle.

etymology_chain.definition: phase, stage, period, level, degree, step

definitions.text_mt: Stadju jew perjodu fi proċess jew żvilupp
Stadju tal-qamar jew ta' pjaneta fid-dawl tagħha

usage_examples.maltese: Din hija fażi importanti ħafna fl-iżvilupp tat-tifel.
usage_examples.english: This is a very important phase in the child's development.

usage_examples.maltese: Il-qamar jgħaddi minn erba' fażijiet ewlenin kull xahar.
usage_examples.english: The moon goes through four main phases every month.

etymology_chain.definition: A type of bean with an edible pod; in Antiquity: cowpea, New Latin: kidney bean

definitions.text_mt: Żerriegħa li tittiekel ta' pjanta leguminoza, ta' kulur, daqs u għamla varji

usage_examples.maltese: Illum se nagħmlu ross u fażola għall-ikla ta' nofsinhar.
usage_examples.english: Today we'll make rice and beans for lunch.

usage_examples.maltese: Il-fażola teħtieġ issajjar għal mill-inqas siegħa qabel ma tittiekel.
usage_examples.english: Beans need to cook for at least an hour before eating.

usage_examples.maltese: Xtrajt żewġ kilo fażola friska mis-suq tal-bdiewa.
usage_examples.english: I bought two kilos of fresh beans from the farmer's market.

definitions.text_mt: Dak li jibqa' wara li jitneħħa l-biċċa l-kbira
Ammont żejjed, dak li hu aktar milli hemm bżonn

usage_examples.maltese: Poġġejna l-fdal tal-ikel fil-friġġ għal għada.
usage_examples.english: We put the leftover food in the fridge for tomorrow.

usage_examples.maltese: M'għadx għandna fdal ta' drapp wara li qatajna l-ilbies.
usage_examples.english: We have no surplus fabric left after cutting the dress.

definitions.text_en: a type of Maltese pasta similar to tagliatelle
definitions.text_mt: Tip ta' għaġin tradizzjonali Malti, simili għat-tagliatelle imma iqsar u usa'

usage_examples.maltese: Il-fdewxa hija għaġin tipiku Malti li ħafna jsajru biż-zafteran.
usage_examples.english: Fdewxa is a typical Maltese pasta that many cook with saffron.

usage_examples.maltese: Illum għall-ikla se nieklu fdewxa bil-ħaxix u l-ġobon.
usage_examples.english: Today for lunch we'll eat fdewxa with vegetables and cheese.

definitions.text_mt: Jeħles lil xi ħadd permezz ta' ħlas
Iħallas biex jeħles lil xi ħadd mill-magħkus
Isalva lil xi ħadd milli jaqa' fil-periklu
Jeħles permezz ta' sagrifiċċju

usage_examples.maltese: Huwa fedu lil ibnu mill-jasar billi ħallas il-fidwa kollha.
usage_examples.english: He ransomed his son from captivity by paying the full ransom.

usage_examples.maltese: Kristu feda lill-bnedmin permezz tas-sagrifiċċju tiegħu.
usage_examples.english: Christ redeemed mankind through his sacrifice.

definitions.text_en: agent noun of feda: redeemer, saviour
definitions.text_mt: Persuna li tifdi, salvatur, min jeħles lil xi ħadd permezz ta' fidwa

usage_examples.maltese: Ġesù hu meqjus mill-insara bħala l-Feddej tal-bnedmin.
usage_examples.english: Jesus is regarded by Christians as the Redeemer of mankind.

usage_examples.maltese: Kull feddej irid ikun lest li jissagrifika għall-oħrajn.
usage_examples.english: Every redeemer must be willing to sacrifice for others.

definitions.text_mt: Relatat ma' federazzjoni, li għandu sistema ta' gvern fejn l-istati huma magħqudin imma awtonomi

usage_examples.maltese: Il-Ġermanja hija repubblika federali b'sittax-il stat.
usage_examples.english: Germany is a federal republic with sixteen states.

usage_examples.maltese: Is-sistema federali tqassam il-poter bejn gvern ċentrali u gvernijiet lokali.
usage_examples.english: The federal system distributes power between a central government and local governments.

definitions.text_mt: Min jemmen fil-federaliżmu jew jappoġġah

usage_examples.maltese: Il-federalists jargumentaw li din is-sistema toffri bilanċ aħjar.
usage_examples.english: The federalists argue that this system offers a better balance.

usage_examples.maltese: Kien federalist konvint u ddefenda l-pożizzjoni tiegħu fil-parlament.
usage_examples.english: He was a convinced federalist and defended his position in parliament.

definitions.text_mt: Segwaċi jew sostenitur tal-federaliżmu
Mara li tappoġġa l-federaliżmu

usage_examples.maltese: Huwa federalista li jemmen fl-għaqda Ewropea.
usage_examples.english: He is a federalist who believes in European unity.

usage_examples.maltese: Hija federalista wkoll u tikteb spiss dwar is-suġġett.
usage_examples.english: She is also a federalist and writes often on the subject.

definitions.text_mt: Sistema politika fejn l-istati jew reġjuni jingħaqdu taħt gvern ċentrali billi jżommu ċertu awtonomija

usage_examples.maltese: Il-federaliżmu jippromwovi l-għaqda fid-diversità fost reġjuni differenti.
usage_examples.english: Federalism promotes unity in diversity among different regions.

usage_examples.maltese: Il-federaliżmu ġie adottat minn bosta pajjiżi bħall-Istati Uniti u l-Ġermanja.
usage_examples.english: Federalism has been adopted by many countries such as the United States and Germany.

definitions.text_mt: Grupp ta' stati, reġjuni jew organizzazzjonijiet magħqudin taħt awtorità ċentrali

usage_examples.maltese: Ir-Russja hija federazzjoni li tinkludi bosta repubbliki u reġjuni.
usage_examples.english: Russia is a federation that includes many republics and regions.

usage_examples.maltese: Il-federazzjoni tal-isport toħroġ regoli għall-kompetizzjonijiet kollha.
usage_examples.english: The sports federation issues rules for all competitions.

definitions.text_en: Russian Federation (official name of Russia: a transcontinental country in Eastern Europe and North Asia)
definitions.text_mt: L-isem uffiċjali tar-Russja, pajjiż transkontinentali fil-Lvant tal-Ewropa u t-Tramuntana tal-Asja

usage_examples.maltese: Il-Federazzjoni Russa hija l-ikbar pajjiż fid-dinja b'erja vasta.
usage_examples.english: The Russian Federation is the largest country in the world by vast area.

usage_examples.maltese: Moska hija l-belt kapitali tal-Federazzjoni Russa.
usage_examples.english: Moscow is the capital city of the Russian Federation.

etymology_chain.definition: inflection of offōcō: present active infinitive second-person singular present passive imperative / indicative

definitions.text_mt: Joqtol jew iweġġa' billi jagħfas il-gerżuma, ma jħallix persuna tieħu n-nifs

usage_examples.maltese: Il-ħalliel fega lill-vittma u ħarab bil-flus minn fuq il-bank.
usage_examples.english: The thief strangled the victim and fled with the money from the counter.

usage_examples.maltese: Tista' tifga jekk tibla' biċċa ikel kbira mingħajr ma tomgħodha sewwa.
usage_examples.english: You can choke if you swallow a large piece of food without chewing it properly.
